role_claude: Reads and writes; shows you a diff before changing the vault
busy: Switch models once the answer is finished
switch: Switch model (another provider starts a new thread)
menu_note: Another provider starts a new thread: the earlier conversation stays in the log, but the new model can't see it. An unavailable model reports an error; it is never swapped for another.
other_hint: Pick one at the top of any chat panel. They are read-only: only Claude changes the vault. If the chosen model is unavailable you get an error, never a substitute.
